searches: Read both held texts (GPO slip-order volume OCR; CSC annual report OCR).

Web, standard, one query: "William A. Hock" Newark post office clerk reinstated 1926. Only hit on point was a Monthly Catalog entry for the order itself (mocat.library.unt.edu/catalog/377-ch1503), read from the search summary only, not opened; nothing on reinstatement or death.
Slice lists no later instrument naming the order, no OFR 1989 table entry and no current-law mention; these were not searched again.

review.conclusion_reason: OPEN is supported: the authorization does not itself perform reinstatement, and neither named source establishes performance, death, express termination, or current operation at the cutoff. Rule (e) requires sourced performance for a spent authorization; elapsed time cannot establish an ending. Formal status is supportable only as the limited finding that no express ending was found in the supplied evidence.
review.stop_code_verdict: wrong (an unsearched-source or SEARCH_NEEDED code fits; the supplied materials provide no stop-code vocabulary and do not establish an OFFLINE barrier)
review.suspected_defect: The first gap's OFFLINE label is unsupported: the evidence slice establishes missing performance or death evidence, not that such evidence is unavailable online. No deliberate quotation alteration was found.

verdicts.reason: The GPO text expressly permits Hock's reinstatement to the specified clerkship without the Civil Service Rules' time limitation.
The held text prints Calvin Coolidge and May 13, 1926. Its header records the closing tag on PDF page 300 as read from OCR; this confirms the header claim, not independent visual verification.
The named Commission report file contains the quoted operative language and the same reinstatement authorization.
The GPO text states 19 years of service and removal on June 30, 1918. Service by about 1899 is supported, but establishes neither death nor performance.
The text expressly states the remedial purpose and contains a single discretionary reinstatement authorization, with no recurring mandate. That does not establish that the authorization ended.
